units.source_text: 在这之后的三四年间，阿民独自一人承担着所有的劳苦。

en.t: For the next three or four years, Amin bore all the hardship by herself.

units.source_text: 那种痛苦就像一匹垂老的马匹，和一匹年轻体健的悍马同负一辄。

en.t: That suffering was like an old, failing horse being made to pull in the same rut as a young, strong, unruly horse.

units.source_text: 阿民依旧天天外出，不辞辛苦的做着田里的工作。

en.t: Amin still went out every day and kept doing the fieldwork without sparing herself any toil.

units.source_text: 阿住也和以前一样操持家务。

en.t: Azumi also managed the household just as she had before.

units.source_text: 但是，总有一根看不见的鞭子在威胁着要抽打阿住。

en.t: But there was always an invisible whip threatening to strike Azumi.

units.source_text: 有时候因为没烧洗澡水，有时候因为忘记晒稻子，有时候因为牛偷偷跑掉了，

en.t: Sometimes it was because she had not heated the bathwater, sometimes because she had forgotten to dry the rice, and sometimes because the cow had slipped away.

units.source_text: 阿住总会因为这样或那样的疏忽被阿民数落一顿。

en.t: For one negligence or another, Azumi would always be scolded by Amin.

units.source_text: 不过她从来不还嘴，只是默默忍受着苦痛。

en.t: Even so, she never talked back, but silently endured the pain.
There were two reasons for this.
First, she had grown used to obedience.

units.source_text: 二是，和阿民相比，孙子广次对自己更加亲近。

en.t: Second, compared with Amin, her grandson Hiroji was closer to her.
